offer_hypothesis.buyer: MTG sellers with decks or collections to list across approved marketplaces
offer_hypothesis.demand_hypothesis: Sellers may pay to turn structured card/deck data into consistent draft listings and reusable listing assets.

candidate_catalog_entry.name: MTG Deck Marketplace Listing Engine
candidate_catalog_entry.description: Generates draft listing content and structured listing data from supplied inventory. It does not publish listings or invent stock.

fulfillment_contract.buyer_input: seller-supplied inventory, condition, asking price, and approved listing template
fulfillment_contract.deliverable: draft listing bundle, field validation report, inventory provenance, and SHA-256
fulfillment_contract.service_boundary: Only the stated input, deliverable, and scope are included. Unsupported inputs, unverified source facts, or out-of-scope work must be surfaced for review.

carousel_card.title: MTG Deck Marketplace Listing Engine
carousel_card.description: Generates draft listing content and structured listing data from supplied inventory. It does not publish listings or invent stock.

implementation_contract.evidence_model: Reuse canonical settlement and fulfillment proof fields; do not create a silo-specific revenue truth schema.
source_criteria: Hash each required source file and record its observed status.
Do not claim a shared implementation exists at a proposed path until the file is present and tested.
Catalogue contract must remain draft with checkout disabled until Gate 1 and fulfilment tests pass.
Settlement must be verified from live provider evidence, with correct SKU, amount, currency, mode, and attribution.
Fulfillment must generate a retrievable artifact, SHA-256, and delivery receipt.
Reject self-purchases, simulations, test-mode payments, missing proofs, and duplicate attribution.

provisioning.reason: Candidate specification only. No checkout URL, deployed per-silo function, completed fulfillment test, or external demand evidence has been established. Current shared Stripe Gate 1 is reported as HTTP 503 STRIPE_CONFIG_MISSING.

economics.truth_boundary: Revenue remains unverified until the canonical ledger independently records a settled external transaction and verified fulfillment.
